tests: Real local Prometheus 3.7.3 processes scraped a synthetic HTTP exporter with a 300-byte device path: 256-byte limit produced up=0 and the expected lastError; 512-byte limit accepted both filesystem samples and memory.
With the published narrow drop rule and limit 256, the real scrape succeeded, retaining /dev/sda and memory while excluding the long path.
All three complete fixture configurations passed matching promtool checks. Local servers stopped and temporary TSDB/configuration directories removed after testing.
Published shell snippet passed bash syntax checking. Four-edge Mermaid flow structurally checked without graphical rendering.
Social image generated and visually reviewed at 1280x720 with readable unclipped title.
limitations: The exporter response was synthetic; no real cAdvisor, Docker storage driver or production Prometheus deployment was exercised.
Loopback plaintext was used only for the temporary local test; deployed authentication/TLS configuration was not tested.
The path-prefix exclusion is illustrative and requires actual sample/coverage review before use.
